# Third-party model source / 第三方模型源码

This folder holds selected BSIM source releases from the `SJTU/` collection. They are reference models, not the model used by the quick-start command. Each release retains its own notices and terms; see [third-party details](../docs/THIRD_PARTY.md). 这里保存从 `SJTU/` 收集的部分 BSIM 源码；快速开始使用的是 `models/FreePDK45/`。各模型适用各自的许可条款。

BSIM-IMG is absent because its beta license restricts redistribution. BSIM-IMG 的 beta 许可限制再分发，因此没有上传。
